# Site Information
> BoldBlog is India's leading dating, relationship, and adult content guide.
> We provide honest reviews, sex education, relationship advice, and adult product guides for Indian adults (18+).
> Content is written in Hinglish (Hindi + English mix) targeting Indian audience.
> All content is legal, educational, and aimed at adults 18 years and above.

## About BoldBlog

BoldBlog.in is a comprehensive resource for Indian adults covering:
- Dating app reviews and comparisons
- Relationship advice and psychology
- Sex education and sexual health
- Adult web series and OTT reviews
- Adult product reviews and guides
- Attraction and seduction psychology

## Content Categories

### Dating Apps
Reviews and comparisons of popular dating apps in India including Tinder, Bumble, Hinge, TrulyMadly, OkCupid, and more. Honest assessments of features, pricing, and user experience for Indian users.

### Relationship Advice
Science-backed relationship advice covering attraction psychology, red flags, communication tips, long distance relationships, and dating tips specific to Indian culture and context.

### Sex Education
Comprehensive sex education content covering safe sex practices, contraception methods, sexual health, STD prevention, and intimate wellness — all written from an educational perspective suitable for Indian adults.

### Adult Reviews
Honest reviews of adult OTT platforms, web series, VPN services for privacy, and adult products available in India. All reviewed content is legally available in India.

### Adult Products
Reviews and buying guides for sexual wellness products legally available in India, including information on where to purchase discreetly and safely.
